status: prospectively frozen before any new normal API import/evaluation/test or independent oracle calculation
purpose: Qualify a separately exposed signed normal-angle derivative for a finite circular segment with supplied H and SPD Gaussian covariance. Preserve existing means/4-column Jacobian and original failed residual v1. No fit/recovery/automatic trace integration or physical optics claim.

operator.name: backend.finite_normal.circular_segment_normal_derivative
operator.panel_scope: per query including attempted analytic panel
operator.evaluation_scope: cumulative across batch in input order
operator.fallback: original source-s adaptive chord quadrature; no finite-difference fallback; failed work retained
operator.signed_units: probability per CCW source-normal radian; no probability clamp; intensity requires signed contrast

oracle.method: Independent direct source-s Gaussian boundary quadrature; no production private helpers or closed-moment use
oracle.cuts: source endpoints, zero, plus inverse-mapped whitened image-line distances 0 and plus/minus multipliers around closest query projection
oracle.tail_guard: Per-panel absolute envelope ds*max_abs_s*abs_detH/min_w^3*Gaussian_normalizer*exp(-minimum_whitened_segment_distance^2/2); tail panels may be zero only with recorded envelope <= 1e-13 / initial panel count
oracle.comparison_allowance: abs + rel*abs(oracle192) + candidate_estimated_error + 2*abs(oracle192-oracle96) + recorded_tail_envelopes; independent convergence also required
oracle.failure_policy: All queries retained; unknown/refusal/nonfinite/order disagreement/overbudget is protocol failure, not removed from population

positive_area_corroboration.policy: Supplemental positive-area rotation finite differences on NEW scenes only; preserve all raw means/orders/step sides and differences. No adaptive step, order, scene or threshold tuning.

strict_inputs: pixels 1..2048 unique in-frame integer pairs no booleans
finite real geometry in existing domains
whole-shape single projective chart including negative homogeneous representation
exact symmetric SPD covariance no repair
metamorphisms: signed isotropic axis-zero/opposite pair and magnitude>1
source scale k with inverse H input scaling
homogeneous H positive/negative powers and nonzero1e-320 perspective classification
input snapshots and immutable output tuples
resource: forced analytic discard and fallback success/exhaustion charge attempted work
unknown first query retained and later affordable query allowed
exact sums and no unreported dropped queries
unexpected internal TypeError/ValueError propagates rather than hiding as successful result
controls.old_api: old probability schema and centre/radius/fraction four-column Jacobian unchanged

source_workflow: Freeze plan first. Unit/preflight repairs may change NEW implementation/runner/tests with all attempts retained. Freeze exact final source hashes before ONE canonical complete study. Preserve failures and never relax frozen criteria or overwrite results.
